title: RunResult
description: Schema for one benchmark run result

run_index.description: 0-based index of this run within the grounding or bisect batch

exit_code.description: Exit code from the benchmark process

wall_time_s.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for the entire run

failure_phase.description: Non-null if the run failed; one of: import, init, runtime, oom, hang

raw_fps_mean.description: Mean frames per second across benchmark frames

raw_fps_median.description: Median frames per second across benchmark frames

gpu_mem_used_mb.description: Peak GPU memory used in megabytes

artifact_dir.description: Relative path to this run's artifact directory under run_dir
